posts.title: ‘INFORMATION’ BC WIN & IN
posts.description: Gulfstream News Release –– The $200,000 Inside Information (G2), a seven-furlong stakes to be run on Pegasus World Cup Day, Saturday, January 30, 2027 at Gulfstream Park, has been added to the Breeders’ Cup Challenge Series. The race will serve as a ‘Win and You’re In’ qualifier for the $1 million Breeders’ Cup Filly & Mare Sprint (GI) at Belmont Park on October 30, 2027. A nominated winner of the Inside Information will receive an automatic starting berth in the Breeders’ Cup F/M Sprint, waived pre-entry and entry fees (or an equivalent fee credit toward another Breeders’ Cup race), a $10,000 nominator award, and travel allowances ($10,000 within North America outside Kentucky; $40,000 internationally) for World Championships starters. The Inside Information joins the $2 million Pegasus World Cup Invitational (G1) as a Breeders’ Cup Challenge Series ‘Win and You’re In’race.The Pegasus remains a ‘ Win and You’re In ’ for the $7 million Breeders’ Cup Classic (G1). posts.title: NFL LEGEND, WAIVE GOODBYE
posts.description: By Marc Lawrence, PlayBookSports.com — Aaron Rodgers called this his final ride back in the spring. Heading into Week 12, Pittsburgh pulled him over and handed the keys to Mason Rudolph. At 42, Rodgers is completing just 60.9 percent of his passes and lugging around the lowest passer rating of his career. And if you’re looking for irony, try this on for size. The franchise that just benched him is the same one he beat to win Super Bowl XLV – the Steelers. Green Bay took Rodgers in the first round in 2005 and made him wait three years behind Brett Favre. He took over in 2008, hoisted the Lombardi Trophy two seasons later, and spent the rest of his career making a living off a simple proposition. His receivers had a better shot at catching the ball than your defensive backs did. Rodgers led the NFL in touchdown-to-interception ratio six times, passer rating four times, touchdown passes twice and completion percentage once.
